title: Extension-host WIT worlds and capability bindings
summary: Component-model WIT worlds and host capability bindings (editor read, workspace read, diff/apply preview, terminal observe, network egress) that fix the extension-host permission window.
compatibility_note: The extension-host WIT worlds publish a versioned capability window; a host and guest negotiate down to the worlds both support, an unknown world fails closed, and a deprecated world is handled by the published capability-diff report rather than silently widening the permission window.
